provenance.writtenFor: DAST app-surface batch 6 (2026-10-21): personal-data patterns, credential material, served artefacts, product consoles and response contracts
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A response carries the evidence DPK-DAST-414 declares: kubeconfig file served with its client key.

groundTruth.rationale: The synthetic response reproduces the exact evidence DPK-DAST-414 inspects for this failure mode, with the rest of the response left ordinary so the finding is attributable to this one property.

observation.body:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Config
clusters:
- name: prod
  cluster:
    server: https://k8s.example:6443
users:
- name: admin
  user:
    client-certificate-data: ZXhhbXBsZS1jZXJ0
    client-key-data: ZXhhbXBsZS1rZXk=

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live target.
A positive case proves the rule fires on this evidence; it is not a claim that a live target behaves the same way.
